rows.label: Antikythera mechanism
rows.description: ancient analog computer designed to calculate astronomical positions
rows.hook: is a corroded bronze gear device from a shipwreck, often called the world's oldest analog computer

rows.label: Ötzi
rows.hook: is a natural mummy of a Copper Age hunter found frozen in an Alpine glacier by hikers

rows.label: Rosetta Stone
rows.description: ancient Egyptian stele with inscriptions in three writing systems
rows.hook: is a carved slab whose parallel texts in three scripts let scholars decipher hieroglyphs

rows.label: Venus de Milo
rows.description: ancient Greek marble statue of a woman
rows.hook: is a famous armless ancient Greek marble sculpture of the goddess of love

rows.label: Lucy
rows.description: fossilized skeleton of a female Australopithecus afarensis
rows.hook: is a partial early-human skeleton named after a Beatles song and found in East Africa

rows.label: Winged Victory of Samothrace
rows.description: statue from Samothrace, Greece in the Louvre, Paris, France
rows.hook: is a headless, wing-bearing marble goddess that seems to land on the prow of a ship

rows.label: Venus of Willendorf
rows.hook: is a tiny prehistoric limestone figurine of a woman with exaggerated curves

rows.label: Piri Reis map
rows.hook: is a fragment of an Ottoman admiral's chart that shows the Atlantic and sparks fringe theories

rows.label: Ishtar Gate
rows.description: eighth gate to the inner city of Babylon
rows.hook: is a dazzling blue glazed-brick entrance to an ancient city, reconstructed for display far from its home

rows.label: Phaistos disc
rows.description: inscribed fired clay tablet found in Crete, covered on both sides with undeciphered spiral Minoan writing
rows.hook: is a spiral-stamped clay circle from Crete whose undeciphered symbols remain a puzzle

rows.label: mask of Tutankhamun
rows.description: gold mask of the Egyptian pharaoh Tutankhamun
rows.hook: is a gold and lapis funerary portrait covering the face of a boy king found in his tomb

rows.label: Bust of Queen Nefertiti
rows.description: bust from the Amarna Period in the Neues Museum, Berlin
rows.hook: is a painted limestone likeness of a royal beauty from the Nile, one of the most copied ancient portraits

rows.label: Nebra sky disk
rows.hook: is a bronze disc inlaid with gold suns, moon and stars, the oldest known concrete sky depiction
